caption: The drawing depicts a single pitcher or jug with a wide body and a narrow neck that flares out at the mouth, featuring a prominent handle attached from the top of the neck to the upper portion of the body. The pitcher is colored primarily in various shades of brown and amber, with wood-like swirling patterns throughout its surface that give it a marbled appearance. There are also curved, light blue or white lines that loop and flow vertically and diagonally from the mouth down the body, creating a decorative pattern. The handle is dark brown with lighter edges, and the base of the jug is a darker brown than the body. The background is plain and off-white, and there is no other object in the image. In the bottom right corner, the name “JANET RIZA” is written.
title: Pitcher
